cases.title: College Tech & Cultural Fest Participation Crisis

scenario.context: A university is organizing its flagship 3-day annual festival in 30 days. Last year suffered from poor turnout (only 350 students). This year the team must attract at least 900 attendees despite two rival college fests happening on the exact same weekend.

metrics.keyConstraint: Overlapping dates with 2 major rival campus festivals

requiredPillars: 1. Target Audience Personas & Unique Fest Positioning vs Rivals
2. Zero-Cost Guerrilla Marketing & Viral Reels Campaign Plan
3. Campus Ambassador Network & Squad Referral Incentive Mechanics
4. Granular ₹20,000 Budget Allocation Table (Line Item | Cost | ROI)
5. 30-Day Phased Execution Timeline (Tease -> Blitz -> Ticket Rush)

bombs.headline: 🚨 BUDGET EMERGENCY: ₹20,000 SLASHED TO ₹4,000!
bombs.description: The college finance committee froze funds! Your marketing budget is slashed from ₹20,000 to ₹4,000. All paid flyers, posters, and paid influencer promotions are immediately revoked.
bombs.directive: Pivot immediately to 100% zero-cost guerrilla tactics, inter-department meme wars, WhatsApp status chains, and 'Squad Pass' group referral bounties.

cases.title: Campus Electric Scooter Rental & Green Mobility Launch

scenario.context: A student startup is launching a shared electric scooter rental service across a sprawling university campus and nearby hostels. Students currently rely on expensive autos or long walks. The startup must prove reliability and overcome student skepticism about battery life.

metrics.keyConstraint: Hostel curfews (9:30 PM) and battery range anxiety

requiredPillars: 1. Brand Positioning & Overcoming Student Range Anxiety
2. Campus Launch Blitz & Subscription Pass Tiers (Daily / Weekly)
3. Battery Swapping SLA & Fleet Rebalancing Logistics Protocol
4. Granular ₹35,000 Budget Allocation & Unit Economics Table
5. 3-Week Phased Rollout Roadmap & Safety Geofencing Rules

bombs.headline: 🚨 INFRASTRUCTURE HALT: 4 OUT OF 6 HUBS DENIED PERMITS!
bombs.description: Campus security blocked electrical connections for 4 out of your 6 charging stations due to power load concerns! You must launch with only 2 operational swap hubs.
bombs.directive: Adapt your operations by introducing mobile battery delivery vans, designated hostel drop zones, and ₹20 ride-credit incentives for riders who return scooters directly to the 2 active hubs.

scenario.context: A hyperlocal quick-commerce app is launching a 15-minute delivery service for hostel students needing instant snacks, stationery, and exam supplies between 7:00 PM and 3:00 AM. Local stores close by 9:00 PM, creating a massive unmet demand.

metrics.keyConstraint: Hostel warden restrictions on external deliveries after 10 PM

requiredPillars: 1. High-Demand Late-Night Snack Catalog & Pricing Structure
2. 15-Minute Fast Order Packing & Bicycle Routing Blueprint
3. Hostel Launch Campaign & Midnight Study Squad Combo Deals
4. Granular ₹25,000 Budget & Courier Shift Incentive Matrix
5. Hostel Gate Handover Protocols & Out-of-Stock Contingency Plan

bombs.headline: 🚨 ENTRY CRACKDOWN: HOSTELS BAN GATE DELIVERIES AFTER 11 PM!
bombs.description: Hostel administration strictly bans delivery couriers from approaching hostel gates past 11:00 PM to curb late-night noise!
bombs.directive: Surgically modify your delivery flow to appoint trusted resident Floor Captains inside each hostel who receive bulk 10:45 PM stock drops and fulfill internal room deliveries seamlessly.

cases.title: Student Smart Budgeting & Micro-Savings App Launch

scenario.context: A fintech startup built a mobile app that helps college students automatically save spare change from daily UPI payments and set weekly pocket-money budgets. Most students overspend in the first 10 days of the month and struggle by month-end.

metrics.keyConstraint: Trust barrier regarding banking data safety & financial skepticism

requiredPillars: 1. Relatable Brand Persona & Student Financial Literacy Framing
2. Viral TikTok/Reels Campaign on 'Month-End Broke Student Struggles'
3. Gamified Savings Streaks, Round-Ups & Peer Accountability Groups
4. Granular ₹30,000 User Acquisition & Cashback Incentive Budget
5. 6-Week Launch Roadmap (Campus Closed Beta -> Public Rollout)

bombs.headline: 🚨 VIRAL RUMOR SCARE: FAKE DATA PRIVACY CONCERNS ON CAMPUS!
bombs.description: An anonymous campus Reddit/WhatsApp rumor falsely claims your app leaks student bank balances to college deans, causing a spike in uninstalls!
bombs.directive: Adapt your prompt to launch a transparent 24-hour 'Open-Vault Trust Campaign' with student-body live security audits, zero-account-linking demo mode, and verified faculty endorsements.

cases.title: Artisan Student Workspace & Specialty Coffee Café

scenario.context: An entrepreneur is opening a vibrant, budget-friendly specialty coffee shop and study café right outside a university district. The space offers high-speed Wi-Fi, silent study pods, and affordable quality coffee to build a daily community of coders, artists, and study groups.

metrics.keyConstraint: Students occupying tables for 4+ hours with a single ₹50 order

requiredPillars: 1. Unique Café Value Proposition & Aesthetic Workspace Ambience
2. Grand Opening Campaign (Free-Coffee Hour & Student Artist Buzz)
3. Fair Workspace Table-Use Pass System & Student-Friendly Menu Combos
4. Granular ₹40,000 Opening Decor, Marketing & Promo Budget Table
5. 14-Day Launch Countdown Checklist & Community Coding/Art Meetups

bombs.headline: 🚨 FIBER OUTAGE: MAIN COMMERCIAL BROADBAND LINE CUT!
bombs.description: Road construction severed the main optical fiber line 48 hours before opening! High-speed internet will be down for the entire first week.
bombs.directive: Pivot opening week messaging into an offline 'Analog Co-Working & Creative Chillout Week' with dual 5G mobile backup hubs, curated offline board games, acoustic study sessions, and 20% discount vouchers.

cases.title: AI Fitness & Pocket-Friendly Healthy Meal Subscription

scenario.context: A health-tech startup offers an affordable daily healthy meal tiffin service paired with a free AI WhatsApp fitness coach for young college students and busy early-career professionals who rely on unhealthy mess food or fast food.

metrics.keyConstraint: Perception that healthy food is bland, boring, and expensive

requiredPillars: 1. Flavor-First Indian Healthy Menu Positioning & Value Proposition
2. 7-Day Free AI WhatsApp Fitness Coach Lead Generation Funnel
3. Tiered Meal Subscription Plans (Lunch-only, 30-Day Fitness Pack)
4. Granular ₹30,000 Sampling, Marketing & Referral Budget Matrix
5. Kitchen Packaging, Daily Delivery Routes & Freshness SLA

bombs.headline: 🚨 INGREDIENT INFLATION: PANEER & CHICKEN COSTS SURGE 50%!
bombs.description: Wholesale market supply disruptions caused the price of core proteins (paneer, chicken, soy) to spike by 50%, threatening your ₹79 price cap!
bombs.directive: Instantly re-engineer the menu with high-protein smart substitutes (sprouted lentils, local mushroom blends, egg-protein bases) and launch a community 'Budget-Gains Recipe Vote' in the app to maintain the ₹79 promise.

cases.title: Indie Mobile Casual Game Global Viral Launch

scenario.context: A 4-person indie gaming studio developed an addictive, physics-based mobile puzzle game with vibrant pixel art. With zero publisher backing, they must generate 50,000 organic downloads in the first month on Google Play and App Store.

metrics.monetization: Rewarded video ads + ₹99 Ad-free cosmetic skins
metrics.keyConstraint: Competing against giant game studios with massive ad budgets

requiredPillars: 1. Game Hook & App Store Optimization (Title, Icon, Video Trailer)
2. Short-Form Video Strategy (TikTok/Reels 'Impossible Level' Clips)
3. Micro-Streamer & Gaming Creator Outreach Campaign
4. Granular ₹25,000 Creator Gifting & Tournament Prize Budget
5. In-Game Social Share Triggers & Daily Login Retention Mechanics

bombs.headline: 🚨 STORE DELAY: IOS APP STORE APPROVAL STUCK IN REVIEW!
bombs.description: Apple App Store flagged an arbitrary guideline issue, delaying the iOS release by 10 days, while Android is approved and live today!
bombs.directive: Double down on an explosive Android-exclusive 'Beta Champion Tournament' with exclusive early-bird skins, while launching an iOS pre-order countdown campaign with exclusive rewards upon release.

cases.title: Sustainable Campus Thrift & Vintage Fashion Marketplace

scenario.context: A student-run sustainable fashion platform allows university students to buy, sell, and upcycle pre-loved clothing, streetwear, and sneakers to make trendy fashion affordable and let students earn extra cash from their closets.

metrics.keyConstraint: Buyer concerns over clothing hygiene, fabric quality, and sizing

requiredPillars: 1. Brand Identity & Eco-Friendly Streetwear Aesthetic
2. Seller Acquisition Blitz (Hostel Room-Wardrobe Cleanout Drive)
3. Hygiene & Quality Verification Standard (Clean-Wash Badge System)
4. Seamless Campus Pickup, Drop-off Kiosks & Delivery Logistics
5. Granular ₹20,000 Packaging, Photography & Pop-Up Promo Budget

bombs.headline: 🚨 VENUE SHUTDOWN: CAMPUS FASHION POP-UP PERMIT REVOKED!
bombs.description: College administrators suddenly canceled your weekend flea market stall permit due to lawn maintenance!
bombs.directive: Shift the physical pop-up into a 24-hour interactive 'Instagram Live Drop & Hostel Flash-Sale Marathon' with live virtual try-ons by student influencers and instant 30-minute hostel room delivery.

cases.title: AI Practical Coding & Tech Career Accelerator

scenario.context: An online learning community is launching an intensive 21-day cohort called 'Zero to AI Fullstack Builder' for college students. Unlike theoretical college courses, this bootcamp focuses on building 5 real-world deployable AI projects with peer code reviews and recruiter demo days.

metrics.keyConstraint: High dropout rates typical in online cohort courses

requiredPillars: 1. Practical Project-First Curriculum Positioning (5 Ship-Ready Projects)
2. Free 2-Hour 'Build Your First AI App' Lead Magnet Workshop Funnel
3. Discord Pair-Programming Accountability Squads & Peer Reviews
4. Granular ₹25,000 Ads, Club Sponsorships & Refund Bounty Budget
5. 14-Day Admissions Roadmap & Recruiter Demo Day Showcase

bombs.headline: 🚨 LEAD MENTOR EMERGENCY: 2 OUT OF 4 MENTORS DROP OUT!
bombs.description: Two key mentors experienced sudden work travel and had to drop out 48 hours before the cohort kick-off!
bombs.directive: Restructure mentorship into daily interactive AI-assisted code review bots, asynchronous project teardown video briefs, and elevate top alumni to lead peer-assisted breakout squads with stipend incentives.

cases.title: Emergency Pet Care & Vet On-Demand Telehealth Platform

scenario.context: A startup is launching an instant 24/7 video consultation and emergency first-aid advice service for pet parents in an urban area where local veterinary clinics close by 8:00 PM. Pet owners frequently panic during late-night emergencies and need immediate qualified guidance.

metrics.onboardedVets: 20 Verified Licensed Veterinarians on Rotational Shifts
metrics.keyConstraint: Building medical trust and emergency video triage reliability

requiredPillars: 1. Empathetic Brand Messaging & 24/7 Emergency Care Value Proposition
2. Late-Night 'Vet on Call' Digital Awareness & Search Ad Campaign
3. 60-Second Video Triage & Doctor Matching Technical SLA Protocol
4. Granular ₹35,000 Marketing, Vet Incentives & Promo Budget Table
5. 3-Week Phased Launch Roadmap & Hospital Transfer Contingency

bombs.headline: 🚨 TRAFFIC SURGE: VIDEO SERVER BOTTLENECK!
bombs.description: A viral pet-influencer reel caused incoming calls to surge 5x beyond video bandwidth capacity, causing video connection lag!
bombs.directive: Implement an instant lightweight WhatsApp-based photo/chat symptom triage bot that resolves minor dietary queries immediately and prioritizes the video line strictly for critical medical emergencies.
